scope: All 24 original manual images; embedded UI screenshots only. Main prose stays in manual.en.json.
method: Visual inspection of original 960x544 images and 4x crops. Rectangles approximate the printed screenshot boundaries. Partial matches indicate readable source fragments plus a consistent display context; they do not certify every pixel or microtext character.
limitations: Unresolved tiny text remains explicitly listed. English headings and numeric values need no translation. This review does not claim pixel-complete localization of embedded screenshot images.
